'''Goff-milk''' was a gold colored milk.<ref name="invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> 

In [[41 ABY]], [[Hapan Security]] agent [[Taryn Zel]] served [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] a meal with goff-milk during his extraction from [[Nova Station]].<ref name="invincible" />
